events.title: A Rival Papal Election Splits the Church
events.description: After the death of Pope Anastasius II, two men were elected pope at the same time: Symmachus and Laurentius. Rival factions backed each claimant, and the dispute became a schism that lasted until 506, when Symmachus was recognized as the sole pope.
events.significance: It was one of the earliest major disputes over a papal succession. It shaped later rules for how popes are chosen.

events.title: Paulus Warns Hitler That the Sixth Army Is Surrounded
events.description: During the Battle of Stalingrad, General Friedrich Paulus sent Adolf Hitler a telegram. It reported that Soviet forces had encircled the German 6th Army.
events.significance: The encirclement led to one of the costliest German defeats of World War II. It is widely seen as a turning point on the Eastern Front.

events.title: Lebanon Gains Independence from France
events.description: Lebanon marked its independence from French control, a date it still celebrates as Independence Day each November 22.
events.significance: The date marks Lebanon's emergence as a sovereign nation. It remains the country's most important national holiday.

events.title: President John F. Kennedy Is Assassinated
events.description: In Dallas, Texas, President John F. Kennedy was shot and killed, and Texas Governor John Connally was seriously wounded. Lee Harvey Oswald was accused of the shooting. Vice President Lyndon B. Johnson was sworn in as the 36th president within hours.
events.significance: The killing shocked the world and became a defining moment in 20th-century American history. It reshaped the country's politics and public memory.

events.title: The Beatles Release the White Album
events.description: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, known to fans as the White Album. It was a sprawling collection of songs in many styles.
events.significance: It is one of the best-known and most influential albums in rock history. It showed the band's range and experimental ambition late in their career.
